text.card: A red giant 1,005 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.98 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,801 K at its surface.
